spans.s:
1 N. of Śiva, the second of
[]
the three syllables in ओम्; see अ.
--2 N. of Brahmā.
--3 The orb of the
moon. --ind.
1 As a particle used
expletively; उ उमेशः Sk.
--2 An
interjection of:-- (a) calling; उ मेति मात्रा
[]
तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चादुमाख्यां सुमुखी जगाम

; (b) anger; (c)
compassion; (d) command; (e) acceptance; (f)
interrogation; or (g) used merely as an
expletive. In the Veda used as an
enclitic copula implying restriction
[]
and emphasis (and, but, on the
other hand, now, I ask &c.);
in classical literature used
chiefly with अथ (अथो), न (नो) and
किम् (किमु); see these words. उ-उ
or उत on the one hand-on the other
hand, partly-partly.

ऊः [अवतीति, अव-क्विप् ऊठ्]
1 N.
of Śiva.
--2 The moon.
--3 A
protector. --ind.
1 A particle used to
introduce a subject.
--2 An
interjection of (a) calling; (b) of
compassion; (c) protection.
